import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb
import os
import re
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
train_path = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
test_path = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
sample_submission_path = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission_null.csv")
output_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Store original test data for submission with EXACT string preservation
original_test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
print(f"Original Test shape: {original_test_df.shape}")

# Load training data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")


def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).strip('"')
    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\t", "\t").replace("\\r", "\r")
    text = text.strip()
    return text


def extract_linguistic_features(text):
    """Extract handcrafted linguistic features for insult detection"""
    if not isinstance(text, str) or text == "" or pd.isna(text):
        return [0] * 10

    # Clean text
    text = text.lower()

    # Feature 1: Uppercase word ratio
    words = re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)
    uppercase_words = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1)
    uppercase_ratio = uppercase_words / len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 0

    # Feature 2: Exclamation mark density
    exclamation_count = text.count("!")
    exclamation_ratio = exclamation_count / len(text) if len(text) > 0 else 0

    # Feature 3: Question mark density
    question_count = text.count("?")
    question_ratio = question_count / len(text) if len(text) > 0 else 0

    # Feature 4: Average word length
    word_lengths = [len(w) for w in words]
    avg_word_length = np.mean(word_lengths) if word_lengths else 0

    # Feature 5: Exclamation + Question combined ratio
    total_punct_density = (
        (exclamation_count + question_count) / len(text) if len(text) > 0 else 0
    )

    # Feature 6: Word count
    word_count = len(words)

    # Feature 7: Punctuation count
    punctuation_count = sum(1 for c in text if c in "!?.,!;:()[]{}\"'")

    # Feature 8: Special character ratio
    special_chars = sum(1 for c in text if not c.isalnum() and not c.isspace())
    special_char_ratio = special_chars / len(text) if len(text) > 0 else 0

    # Feature 9: Suffix "!?" pattern (aggressive ending)
    aggressive_pattern = 1 if text.rstrip()[-1] in "!?!" else 0

    # Feature 10: Repetitive character ratio (e.g., '!!!!' or '????')
    repeated_chars = (
        len(re.findall(r".{4,}", text.replace(" ", ""))) / len(text)
        if len(text) > 0
        else 0
    )

    return [
        uppercase_ratio,
        exclamation_ratio,
        question_ratio,
        avg_word_length,
        total_punct_density,
        word_count,
        punctuation_count,
        special_char_ratio,
        aggressive_pattern,
        repeated_chars,
    ]


# Apply text cleaning to training data
train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_cleaned = pd.DataFrame()
test_cleaned["Comment"] = original_test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Extract target
y_train = train_df["Insult"].astype(int).values
X_train_raw = train_df["Comment"]
X_test_cleaned = test_cleaned["Comment"]

# Split data for validation (80-20) - random_state for reproducibility
X_val, X_test_split, y_val, y_test_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw, y_train, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
)

print(f"Train after split: {len(X_train_raw) - len(X_val) - len(X_test_split)}")
print(f"Validation: {len(X_val)}")
print(f"Test split: {len(X_test_split)}")
assert len(X_val) + len(X_test_split) == len(
    X_train_raw
), f"Data integrity failed: {len(X_val)} + {len(X_test_split)} = {len(X_val) + len(X_test_split)} != {len(X_train_raw)}"

# Extract handcrafted features for ALL datasets
print("Extracting linguistic features...")
X_train_lang_features = np.array(
    [extract_linguistic_features(comment) for comment in X_train_raw]
)
X_val_lang_features = np.array(
    [extract_linguistic_features(comment) for comment in X_val]
)
X_test_split_lang_features = np.array(
    [extract_linguistic_features(comment) for comment in X_test_split]
)
X_test_lang_features = np.array(
    [extract_linguistic_features(comment) for comment in X_test_cleaned]
)

print(
    f"Linguistic features shape - Train: {X_train_lang_features.shape}, Val: {X_val_lang_features.shape}, Test split: {X_test_split_lang_features.shape}, Final test: {X_test_lang_features.shape}"
)

# Vectorization - fit on training data only
print("Vectorizing text...")
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=1, max_df=0.95
)
word_features = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
word_val = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
word_test = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_split)

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(2, 4), analyzer="char_wb", min_df=1, max_df=0.95
)
char_features = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
char_val = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
char_test = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_split)

X_train_vec = hstack([word_features, char_features])
X_val_vec = hstack([word_val, char_val])
X_test_split_vec = hstack([word_test, char_test])

# Combine TF-IDF features with linguistic features
X_train_final = hstack([X_train_vec, X_train_lang_features])
X_val_final = hstack([X_val_vec, X_val_lang_features])
X_test_split_final = hstack([X_test_split_vec, X_test_split_lang_features])
X_test_final = hstack(
    [
        word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_cleaned),
        char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_cleaned),
        X_test_lang_features,
    ]
)

print(
    f"Total features - Train: {X_train_final.shape[1]}, Val: {X_val_final.shape[1]}, Test split: {X_test_split_final.shape[1]}, Final test: {X_test_final.shape[1]}"
)

# Train Model - fit only on training data (NOT validation)
print("Training XGBoost model...")
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    learning_rate=0.03,
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=6,
    min_child_weight=1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    objective="binary:logistic",
    random_state=42,
    use_label_encoder=False,
    eval_metric="logloss",
    n_jobs=-1,
    tree_method="hist",
    verbosity=0,
)
model.fit(X_train_final, y_train)

# Validate on held-out validation set
y_val_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_val_final)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred_prob)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Final Prediction on Test
test_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test_final)[:, 1]

# Prepare Submission - Use EXACT original test_df structure and values
submission_df = original_test_df.copy()
submission_df = submission_df[["Comment", "Date"]]
submission_df["Insult"] = test_pred_prob

# Ensure predictions are in valid range
submission_df["Insult"] = submission_df["Insult"].clip(0, 1)

# Ensure proper precision (round to 10 decimal places for submission)
submission_df["Insult"] = submission_df["Insult"].round(10)

# Verify format matches test set
comments_match = (
    submission_df["Comment"].astype(str).values
    == original_test_df["Comment"].astype(str).values
).all()
dates_match = (
    submission_df["Date"].astype(str).values
    == original_test_df["Date"].astype(str).values
).all()
print(f"Comments match: {comments_match}")
print(f"Dates match: {dates_match}")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission_df)}")
print(f"Test rows: {len(original_test_df)}")

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {output_path}")

print(f"\nFinal Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")
plan: I will improve the solution by adding handcrafted linguistic features specifically tuned for insult detection: uppercase word ratio (insults often use ALL CAPS for emphasis), exclamation/question mark density, word length statistics, and punctuation ratios. These features will be combined with the existing TF-IDF word and character features using the same XGBoost hyperparameters, creating a richer representation of linguistic patterns associated with insults. This improvement is atomic and distinct from the previous solution which only used TF-IDF features.
